1.text: Kuvugwa neza kuruta amavuta atamye y'igiciro cyinshi, kandi umunsi wo gupfamo uruta umunsi wo kuvukamo.

2.text: Kujya mu rugo rurimo imiborogo biruta kujya mu rugo rurimo ibirori, kuko ibyo ari byo herezo ry'abantu bose, kandi ukiriho azabihorana ku mutima we.

3.text: Agahinda karuta guseka, kuko agahinda kagaragaye mu maso kanezeza umutima.

4.text: Umutima w'abanyabwenge uri mu nzu y'imiborogo, ariko umutima w'abapfapfa uri mu nzu y'ibyishimo.

5.text: Ibyiza ni ukwemera guhanwa n'umunyabwenge kuruta kumva indirimbo y'abapfapfa.

6.text: Kuko guseka k'umupfapfa kumeze nk'amahwa aturagurikira munsi y'inkono, ibyo na byo ni ubusa.

7.text: Ni ukuri agahato gahindura umunyabwenge umupfapfa, kandi impongano zica ubwenge.

8.text: Iherezo ry'ikintu riruta intangiro yacyo, uw'umutima wihangana aruta uw'umutima w'umwibone.

9.text: Ntukihutire kurakara mu mutima, kuko uburakari buba mu mutima w'umupfapfa.

10.text: Ntukavuge uti “Ni iki cyatumye ibihe bya kera biruta iby'ubu?” Ubwenge si bwo buguteye kubaza utyo.

11.text: Ubwenge buhwanije ubwiza nk'ibyo umuntu arazwe, ndetse burushaho kubonerera abakireba izuba.

12.text: Kuko ubwenge ari ubwugamo nk'uko ifeza ari ubwugamo, ariko umumaro wo kumenya ni uyu: ni uko ubwenge burinda ubugingo bw'ubufite.

13.text: Itegereze umurimo w'Imana. Ni nde wabasha kugorora icyo yagoretse?

14.text: Ku munsi w'amahirwe ujye wishima, no ku munsi w'amakuba ujye utekereza yuko Imana ari yo yaremye byombi ikabibangikanya, kugira ngo umuntu atazabona ibizaba mu nyuma ze.

15.text: Ibi byose nabibonye mu minsi namaze y'impfabusa: habaho umukiranutsi ukenyuka kandi akiranuka, kandi habaho umunyabyaha uramba kandi akora ibibi.

16.text: Ntugakabye gukiranuka kandi ntiwigire umunyabwenge burengeranye. Ni kuki wirimbuza?

17.text: Ntugashayishe gukora ibibi ntukabe n'umupfapfa. Byakumarira iki gukenyuka?

18.text: Ibyiza ni uko bimwe ubikomeza ndetse ibindi ntukabikureho iminwe, kuko uwubaha Imana azava muri ibyo byose.

19.text: Ubwenge butera umunyabwenge imbaraga kuruta abatware cumi bari mu mudugudu.

20.text: Ni ukuri nta mukiranutsi uri mu isi, ukora neza ntacumure.

21.text: Kandi ntukite ku magambo yose avugwa, kugira ngo utumva umugaragu wawe agutuka,

22.text: kuko kenshi mu mutima wawe nawe uzi ko watukaga abandi.

23.text: Ibi byose nabigerageje mu bwenge. Naravuze nti “Nzaba umunyabwenge”, ariko bumba kure.

24.text: Ibiriho biri kure ikuzimu cyane, ni nde wabishyikira?

25.text: Ndahindukira maramaje mu mutima kumenya no kugenzura no gushaka ubwenge, no guhanuza ibintu no kumenya ko ibibi ari ubupfapfa, kandi ko ubupfapfa ari ibisazi.

26.text: Maze mbona ikintu kirusha urupfu kurura: ni umugore umeze nk'umutego n'inshundura, n'amaboko ye akaba nk'ingoyi. Unezeza Imana azamurokoka, ariko umunyabyaha azafatwa na we.

27.text: Umubwiriza aravuga ati “Dore iki ni cyo nabonye negeranya kimwe n'ikindi, kugira ngo menye impamvu zabyo,

28.text: ari cyo umutima wanjye ugishaka ariko sindakibona: mu bagabo igihumbi nabonye umwe, ariko mu bagore bose nta n'umwe nabonye.

29.text: Dore icyo nabonye gusa ni iki: ni uko Imana yaremye umuntu utunganye, ariko abantu bishakiye ibihimbano byinshi.”
